name: Rosetta Stone
tagline: Rosetta Stone is one of the oldest and most recognised language learning brands, now offering a fully digital, AI-driven immersive learning experience in 25 languages. Its TruAccent speech-recognition engine gives instant pronunciation feedback, and lessons are structured to build intuition through context — like how children learn — rather than grammar rules. It's popular with adults and institutions seeking a rigorous, structured approach.
